title: CouncilConfig
description: Configuration for the henka-council governance layer (.council/config.json).

target_project.description: Name or path of the target project being governed.

autonomy_level.description: Nominal autonomy level (0–5). Subject to dynamic floor (R10).

review_frequency.description: How often the council convenes for review.

cycle_length.description: Number of sprints per PDCA cycle. Default 5.

dispatch_mode.description: Agent dispatch mode. Sequential by default in v0.1.

andon_takt_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout in seconds for andon alert swarm resolution. Default 600.

dynamic_autonomy_thresholds.description: Thresholds governing dynamic autonomy floor drops (R10).

consecutive_fail_count.description: Number of consecutive sprint FAILs before floor drops. Default 2.

andon_stop_consecutive_count.description: Number of consecutive andon-stop events before floor drop. Default 3.

andon_stop_distinct_originators_required.description: Distinct originator agents required for andon-stop floor drop trigger. Default 2.

halt_conditions.description: Conditions that trigger a halt in the autorun loop.

custom_henkaten_categories.description: Project-specific custom sub-types beyond the built-in 13.

category_id.description: Unique identifier for this custom category.

fourM_axis.description: Primary 4M axis for this custom category.

irreversible_overrides.description: Commands moved out of the reversibility denylist with Level 5 ratification.

direction_check.description: Configuration for the work-start direction gate (scripts/direction-check.py Layer A + the direction-guardian agent Layer B). Flags work that diverges from the strategic anchor. Absent/disabled = the gate is inert (off by default).

enabled.description: Master switch. When false or absent, the direction gate does nothing.

anchor_path.description: Repo-relative path to the strategic-anchor document, e.g. docs/divorce-spec.md. Drift from this doc is the failure the gate catches.

locked_decisions.description: Binding decision identifiers a contract should cite, e.g. ['ADR-0008'].

killed_workstreams.description: Retired/forbidden workstream keywords. Reintroducing one on mainline/undeclared work BLOCKS. Keep these specific (e.g. 'cmpx writer', not 'writer') to avoid false positives on sanctioned work.

mainline_branch.description: The sanctioned-direction branch. Work on any other branch is 'divergent' and must carry a charter declaring its exploration_mode.

enforcement.description: Tier applied to the trine-eval seam: 'block' aborts the sprint on a BLOCK verdict; 'warn' only surfaces it. The in-session council gate always honors the per-check tiers.

tier_overrides.description: Per-check severity overrides, mapping a check id (e.g. 'missing_anchor_citation', 'killed_workstream_mainline', 'no_charter_divergent_branch') to 'pass' | 'warn' | 'block'.

open_draft_pr.description: When true, the in-session gate opens a draft PR carrying the charter + verdict at work-start.

workflow.description: Name of the installed direction-check GitHub Action workflow file.
